name: Sliding Underline Link
description: A link underline that wipes in on hover and correctly wraps across multiple lines, using an animated background-size instead of a transform.
usage: Add the styles.css to your stylesheet and apply the .su-link class to any anchor; tune color and thickness per instance with the --su-color and --su-thickness custom properties, or use the --reverse, --bold, and --retract modifiers.
